name: Ray Tracing Kernel
aliases: Ray Tracing Kernel — CUDA Ray Tracing Kernel (Backward), CUDA Ray Tracing Kernel (Forward), render_ray_backward_kernel, render_ray_image_kernel, render_ray_kernel
definition: CUDA kernel launching structure for forward and backward ray tracing through a sparse grid volume, handling SH evaluation and ray bounds.
summary: The Ray Tracing Kernel is a CUDA compute kernel that performs forward and backward volumetric ray marching through a sparse hashed density grid, handling spherical harmonics evaluation and ray bounds.
